purpose: Teach: フォワード/グレート/ケルト/カルマ/ショッキング/悪者/ワニ/ひぐらし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカー部でフォワードだったろ
lines.en: Riku — weren't you a forward on the soccer team?
lines.style: Playful tease, light and knowing. Leans in slightly. Testing him, enjoying the moment. Pace stays quick, easy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でグレート・ギャツビー読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were reading The Great Gatsby in your English textbook, Sakura.
lines.style: Cool deflection, turning her observation back on her. Dry half-smile in the voice. Not defensive—matched her move. Even tempo, casual.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でケルト民族習ったろ
lines.en: Riku — didn't you study Celtic peoples in history class?
lines.style: Pressing forward, enjoying the back-and-forth. Brighter attack this time. Almost a laugh underneath the question. Quick, teasing cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画でカルマって言葉使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You used the word 'karma' in a manga discussion once, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady counter, still wry. Leans back slightly. He's not fighting back hard, just matching her. Knowing tone, like he's been collecting these moments.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ショッキングなSNS投稿に驚いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you actually jumped when that shocking post showed up on social media.
lines.style: Slight victory in the opening. Softer underneath, genuinely amused. Quick pace building the observation. Trailing slight laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画の悪者キャラ好きだったよな、桜
lines.en: You had a soft spot for the villain characters in manga, remember?
lines.style: Knowing smirk underneath the words. Unhurried, confident. He's won this round and he knows it. Warm wryness, not cold. Slight pause before 'villain.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、動物園でワニの前で固まってたな
lines.en: Riku — you froze solid standing in front of the crocodile at the zoo.
lines.style: Pure delight now. Laughing at him, but with him. Quick, bright attack on the opening. No mercy, but genuine affection underneath. Playful energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、田舎で夏にひぐらし聴いたって話してたろ、桜
lines.en: You told me you heard the cicada song in the countryside during summer, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft landing. Slower pace here, almost gentle. He's saving this one—it's quieter, more intimate. Not a win, but a shared moment. Close to her, voice drops slightly.
